messages:
lina: Heads-up — kicking off a stability dry-run for Python + TS SDKs in the 90m change window. Plan: publish canary artifacts to internal registries, route ~10% internal infra/test cohort, run smoke + perf harness, and watch latency/error signals. @sam will handle dist-tags/publish, @maria_s draft a short release-note stub, @alexg will watch rollout.

sam: Artifacts built and uploaded. Tagged as `stability-run-3560012345`. Commands used: `npm publish --tag stability-run-3560012345` and `twine upload --repository-url https://test.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/*`. Internal npm: https://npm.internal.redwood/@redwood/sdk/-/sdk-1.3.3-stability.tgz

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish job started and completed for npm + pypi-staging. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/3560012345/output — all unit checks green.

maria_s: Drafted release-note snippet: "Dry-run: stability testing; no GA changes. Note: legacy sync client is slated for deprecation in next stable — include migration pointers." Draft link: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/stability-3560012345

alexg: Routing 10% internal cohort now (feature flag: `sdk_stability_cohort` -> 10%). Dashboard: https://observability.redwood.example/d/sdk-stability-run

lina: Monitoring thresholds set: median latency baseline ±7%, p99 ±10%, error-rate >0.8% absolute triggers pause. Also metric watch for memory deltas and token billing change.

toni: Quick FYI: reduced bundler chunking landed on the branch that built these artifacts. Could be relevant if we see cold-start/js parse regressions.

lina: Observed: p99 latency +14% and error-rate up to 2.1% for canary traffic in us-east-1 within 12m of routing. CPU profile shows longer JS parse times on some clients. Pausing cohort and gathering traces.

alexg: Pausing confirmed. Please execute rollback and remove dist-tag. Sam, can you pin affected infra to 1.3.2 until we validate?

sam: Running rollback: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk stability-run-3560012345` then unpublish from internal registry where allowed; removed staging wheel from TestPyPI. Flipping feature flag back to 0%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback steps completed. Traffic reverted to stable release. Rollback CI: https://ci.redwood.example/3560012345/rollback — status: success :white_check_mark:.

maria_s: Updating release notes: "Stability dry-run paused due to regional perf regression; GA/stable remains unchanged. Investigation underway; follow-up planned." I'll also add a short note about the deprecation pointer for the sync client and link to migration docs.

toni: Preliminary root cause looks like the new bundler chunking + minify step increased client parse time in some edge cases. Repro steps and a small perf harness will be added to the SDK repo.

alexg: Action items: 1) revert bundler change on the canary branch, 2) add targeted perf regression test for us-east-1 like payloads, 3) re-run dry-run next Wed 09:00 UTC, 4) cut a pinned advisory for ops teams (pin to 1.3.2). I'll file the follow-up ticket and assign owners.

lina: I'll attach collected traces and flamegraphs to the ticket and list exact abort metrics.

sam: Opening PR to pin internal consumers to 1.3.2 for affected infra: https://github.com/redwood/internal-configs/pull/421.

alexg: Thanks everyone. Keeping public-facing changelog unchanged for now. We'll circulate an internal note summarizing the rollback and next steps. :thumbsup:
